LG07.title: 높이를 바꾸면 달라지는 범위
phases: 주변 건물은 그대로 · 앞 건물 높이 변경

renderer: Retain16 original math clips;9 independently editable Manim3D mesh/bounds explanations. Reuse existing numerical renderer for directly computed point bounds; no duplicate Unity game-behaviour implementation.

models.head: Recognizable articulated mannequin with head, eyes, nose, torso, limbs/joints. Three green great circles enclose the head as an illustrative sphere.
models.animation: Shoulder rotations extend both arms; recompute AABB from displayed mesh points during the motion.
models.building: Walls, pitched roof, chimney, windows and door; AABB includes roof-corner empty space.
models.overlap: Two separated slender beams at45 degrees; parallel world bounds overlap despite geometric separation.
models.rotation: Fixed bridge center, green object-attached bounds rotate; blue world AABB recalculated.
models.camera: Hold object points and world bounds fixed; only camera changes.
models.height: Stretch building vertically about its base; recompute mesh bounds, not screen dimensions.

coordinateConvention: Own RH columns, XY horizontal/Zup; game marks are screen-space editorial guidance, no inferred collision telemetry.
